Method of Attack: Remote access Trojan with capabilities to steal cryptocurrency wallet data and browser cookies
Anti-VM and process checks to detect sandbox environments
Kills processes of monitoring tools and browsers to unlock user profiles
Steals Bitcoin and Litecoin wallet.dat files
Exfiltrates browser cookies, usernames, passwords, session data
Receives commands from C2 servers to download and execute additional payloads
Collects hardware ID and country information
Kills specific processes on victim machine
Collects text documents from desktop under 2MB
Impacted Systems: Web browsers (Chrome, Yandex, Kometa, Amigo, Torch, Orbitum, Opera, Mozilla)
Attack Vector: Malware infection leading to execution of %AppData%/NvidiaDriver.exe

Command and control (C2) servers used to send commands and receive stolen data
Processes monitored and killed: Process Hacker, Process Explorer, Process Monitor, Chrome, Yandex, Kometa, Amigo, Torch, Orbitum, Opera, Mozilla
